foundation.title: Live foundation
foundation.description: Real authentication, MFA and tenant-scoped company/project records. This is separate from the mock business dashboards.
foundation.development: Local development only: verification, reset and invitation messages go to Mailpit on localhost:8025. Phone messages use a development mailbox. Use synthetic identities; no external SMS or real payments are sent.
foundation.limitations: Foundation review, not production approval. External SMS, WhatsApp and email providers, mobile device binding and action-bound financial approvals are not implemented; phone messages go to the development mailbox. Payroll, payment providers, biometric capture and offline business sync remain later-phase work.
foundation.signedOut: You are signed out. Register and verify an account, or sign in.
foundation.mfaNeeded: Complete MFA before accessing company records.
foundation.freshMfaHint: Company creation and privileged actions require MFA verified within five minutes. Verify a fresh authenticator code or use a passkey when required; a code can be used only once.
foundation.enrollHint: Sign in with your password within the last five minutes (or, if you already have a passkey, verify it first), then add the secret to an authenticator app. Setup expires after ten minutes.
foundation.secretHint: Sensitive setup secret: enter it manually in your authenticator. It is not stored in browser storage. Hide it on shared devices.
foundation.recoveryHint: These codes are shown once and are not stored in your browser. Save them securely before leaving or refreshing the session. Each code can be used once; recovery does not remove MFA.
foundation.savedCodes: I saved the codes; hide them
foundation.passkeysHint: Use a passkey (your phone or computer screen lock, or a security key) as your second factor and to confirm sensitive actions. Adding one needs a sign-in within the last five minutes or, once you have an MFA factor, a fresh MFA check.
foundation.passkeysUnsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Use an authenticator app instead.
foundation.passkeysLoadHint: Load the workspace to see your passkeys.
foundation.passkeyRemoveHint: Removing a passkey needs a fresh MFA check. Your last MFA factor cannot be removed while your role requires MFA.
foundation.loadHint: Use Load companies, projects and sessions to retrieve current records. Empty lists are not demo data.
foundation.auditLimit: Latest 100 events. Only safe event summaries are displayed, not sensitive field values.
foundation.rolesHint: System roles are fixed. Custom roles combine catalogue permissions, and you can only grant permissions you hold yourself. Every change needs an MFA code verified in the last five minutes.
foundation.tenantWide: Applies to all projects in the company
foundation.tenantWideHint: Otherwise holders act only on projects they are assigned to, within that assignment.
foundation.changeRoleHint: The member's active sessions in this company are signed out so the new permissions apply. Only roles whose permissions you hold are offered.

errors.network: The API could not be reached or the request timed out. Check connectivity and reload current records before repeating a change.
errors.invalidResponse: The API returned an unexpected response. No success is assumed. Check system status and report the support reference.
errors.validation: Check the entered values and required formats.
errors.unauthorized: Credentials, code, token or session could not be verified. Check your input or sign in again. No automatic retry was made.
errors.forbidden: This action is not allowed. Check your role's permissions and project access, sign in again if needed, and verify a fresh MFA code for privileged actions. You cannot grant permissions you do not hold.
errors.notFound: The record or invitation is unavailable, expired or not accessible to this account.
errors.conflict: The request conflicts with current state. Reload records before retrying; used codes, removing or demoting the last owner, duplicate role or passkey names, deleting roles still in use and removing your last MFA factor while your role requires MFA are not allowed.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again; requests are not retried automatically.
errors.unavailable: A required service is unavailable. Check system status; no success is assumed.
errors.unexpected: The request failed unexpectedly. Check system status and report the support reference; no success is assumed.
errors.passwordWeak: This password is too easy to guess. Use a longer passphrase that does not contain your name, email address, phone number or PM-Buddy.
errors.passwordBreached: This password appears in a known data breach. Choose a different password that you do not use anywhere else.
errors.passkeyInvalid: The passkey could not be verified. Start again: each passkey prompt can be used once and expires after five minutes.
errors.passkeyCancelled: The passkey prompt was cancelled, timed out or is not available on this device. Nothing was changed.

help.upload: Excel .xlsx or .xls, at most 10 MB. The type is checked from the content, archives are checked for zip bombs, and the original is kept privately with its SHA-256.
help.sheets: PM-Buddy scored each sheet. Include the bills and the grand summary, and set each bill's number and name and its rows.
help.columns: Choose which column holds each field. The header row is highlighted; formula cells are marked.
help.validate: Every amount is recomputed from quantity × rate and every total is reconciled. Errors block the commit; warnings need accepting with a reason.
help.review: Check what will be created. The commit writes everything in one transaction, or nothing.
